meaning: A phone keyboard feature that fixes misspelled words as you type.
clues: It fixes a misspelled word as you type. It does not take speech, guess the next word, or swap a saved phrase.
It may underline or replace a word that the keyboard thinks is wrong.
You can often undo its change or add a word to your personal dictionary.
It works while you type a text or note on a phone.
It has eleven letters and starts with A.

decoys.meaning: A phone feature that turns spoken words into written words.
A keyboard feature that suggests the next word while you type.
A shortcut that expands a short set of letters into a saved word or phrase.

exchange.text: Try typing a short note. If a word changes by itself, tap the delete key right away to undo the change.

exchange.text: We proofread a letter before we mailed it, because a mailed letter could not be taken back. Reading a text before you send it works the same way.
